name: Appalachia Area Agency on Aging
organization: Appalachia Area Agency on Aging / Aging and Disability Resource Center (Region 1)
description: The Area Agency on Aging and Aging and Disability Resource Center for this county (Region 1, Appalachia): information and referral, home-delivered meals, transportation, in-home care, family caregiver support and the regional long-term care ombudsman.
